task.description:
Implement EPIC-3 (ISS-301, ISS-302, ISS-303) per the approved design in src/design/scheduler-concurrency-epic3.md.

## Prerequisites
- Create feature branch: `git checkout -b feature/WF02-epic3-scheduler-20260612`
- Read the design doc fully before writing any code
- Read the existing scheduler.zig fully before making changes

## ISS-301: Remove redundant advisory lock from poll loop

In `processNextDueTimer` in `src/scheduler/scheduler.zig`:
- Remove the `pg_try_advisory_xact_lock` query block (approx lines 207-238)
- Remove the `lock_key` / `lock_key_text` computation
- Keep `FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED` in the SELECT query (this is the actual protection)
- Remove or keep `advisoryLockKey`/`advisoryLockKeyText` helpers per design (if ISS-302 uses a fixed constant, these may be removable — confirm with design doc)
- The outer `PollSummary.skipped_locked` counter changes: `.skipped_locked` outcomes now only come from `FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED` row-level contention (no rows returned when all due timers are locked by other workers)

## ISS-302: Startup sweep advisory lock

In `pollDueTimers` in `src/scheduler/scheduler.zig`:
- Add startup sweep guard at the beginning when `self.is_startup_sweep == true`
- Use `pg_try_advisory_lock(SCHEDULER_STARTUP_LOCK_ID)` (session-level) on a dedicated connection
- If NOT acquired: log WARN, set `is_startup_sweep = false`, proceed to normal polling
- If acquired: run sweep loop (existing logic unchanged), then call `pg_advisory_unlock(SCHEDULER_STARTUP_LOCK_ID)` on the same connection after completing all sweep iterations
- `SCHEDULER_STARTUP_LOCK_ID` = hard-coded i64 constant from design doc
- Add `startup_sweep_lock_id: i64` field to `SchedulerConfig` if design specifies it, otherwise hard-code

## ISS-303: Route exhausted-retry timers to FAILED + DLQ

### Migration 089
Create `migrations/089_iss303_timer_fire_error_count.sql`:
- Per-tenant, idempotent (uses `to_regclass()` guard like migration 081)
- Add `timers.fire_error_count INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0`
- Add `timers.failed_at TIMESTAMPTZ NULL`
- See design doc for exact SQL

### Scheduler changes in `src/scheduler/scheduler.zig`:
- Add `max_timer_fire_retries: u32 = 3` to `SchedulerConfig`
- Add a `markTimerFailedInTx(conn, timer_id_text, instance_id_text, payload_json, retry_count)` private function that:
  - UPDATE timers SET status='failed', failed_at=NOW() WHERE id=$1
  - INSERT into dead_letter_queue (entry_type, instance_id, reason, ..., item_type='TIMER', source_ref=timer_id)
  - Both in the same transaction as the caller
- When `processNextDueTimer` catches a firing error:
  - Increment `fire_error_count` (UPDATE timers SET fire_error_count = fire_error_count + 1 WHERE id=$1)
  - Check the updated count; if >= `max_timer_fire_retries`: call `markTimerFailedInTx`
  - Roll back or commit accordingly
  - Return appropriate `PollOutcome` (suggest a new `.failed` variant or reuse `.none`)

Note: Look at how `moveToDlq` in `src/dlq/store.zig` works and replicate the INSERT directly in `markTimerFailedInTx` to keep it in the same transaction (do not call moveToDlq which acquires its own connection).

## Validation

After implementing:
```
zig build                          # Must exit 0, no errors
zig build test                     # All tests pass
zig build migrate                  # Migration 089 applies cleanly
```

Also run the error-set validation:
```
zig build 2>&1 | grep -i "error set"
```
If any output: fix all error-set declarations before completing.

## Self-review checklist
- [ ] ISS-301: No `pg_try_advisory_xact_lock` in processNextDueTimer
- [ ] ISS-301: `FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED` still present in SELECT
- [ ] ISS-302: Startup sweep uses session-level `pg_try_advisory_lock` (NOT `xact_lock`)
- [ ] ISS-302: Lock released via `pg_advisory_unlock` after sweep completes
- [ ] ISS-303: Migration 089 is idempotent with `to_regclass()` guard
- [ ] ISS-303: `markTimerFailedInTx` does UPDATE + DLQ INSERT in same tx
- [ ] No SQL string interpolation (prepared statements only)
- [ ] `zig build` exits 0 with no error-set warnings
- [ ] Feature branch committed and pushed

## Commit and complete
```bash
git add -A
git commit -m "feat(epic3): scheduler concurrency — remove redundant lock, startup sweep guard, timer DLQ routing"
git push origin feature/WF02-epic3-scheduler-20260612
```
acceptance_criteria: ISS-301: pg_try_advisory_xact_lock removed from processNextDueTimer; SKIP LOCKED retained
ISS-302: startup sweep guarded by pg_try_advisory_lock; session-level lock acquired+released
ISS-303: migration 089 adds fire_error_count + failed_at; markTimerFailedInTx atomically updates + inserts DLQ entry

result.summary: ISS-301: pg_try_advisory_xact_lock removed from processNextDueTimer; ISS-302: startup sweep guarded by pg_try_advisory_lock (session-level); ISS-303: migration 092 adds fire_error_count+failed_at, markTimerFailedInTx routes exhausted timers to DLQ. zig build exits 0. Pre-existing auth test failures (5 tests in test_api08_auth.zig) are present on main branch — not introduced by EPIC-3.
